title: THE TOMBS OF KINGS // DRAGON EGGS UNDER ICE
narrative: Jon Snow steps past the ancient stone kings of winter, each holding an iron longsword across his lap. In the deepest, collapsed corridor beneath the foundations of the First Men, he reaches the sepulcher of Lyanna Stark. Hidden behind the stone effigy lies a velvet-lined rosewood chest containing Rhaegar Targaryen's silver-stringed harp, a wedding cloak of cloth-of-gold and blue winter roses, and three stone dragon eggs pulsing with hot subterranean steam.

options.text: Summon Howland Reed to verify the marriage lines and lineage.
Place the dragon egg into the boiling volcanic springs beneath the castle.
Rhaegar's distortion pedal: Mance Rayder reveals the silver harp plays high-gain progressive rock.
options.introducesPlotHole: Rhaegar's High Valyrian Glamor Distortion Pedal
